note: PLUGIN-002 bound frames: the length prefix in src/plugin/protocol.zig is validated inside the digit loop, so a huge declared length is refused on the way in rather than after being assembled, the header itself is read into a fixed buffer, and the body must be a complete JSON document before it is returned - nothing partial is ever handed to a dispatcher. The test exercises a valid frame, an eleven-digit declared length, a length that fits the header digits but exceeds the limit, a body that is not JSON, a truncated document, a body shorter than declared, a non-numeric header, an empty header, an empty stream, and a frame exactly at the limit, since a boundary that only works below itself is not a boundary. Fault proof: widening the bound a thousandfold accepts an above-limit frame and the oversized assertion fails (exit 1). The first attempt at this fault was a no-op because the in-loop check still fired - a passing run, not rejected evidence - and it was replaced with one that changes the behavior under test.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
